FirstPeriodIrregular.1:
Lḥiḍ-iw amezwaru ur yelli ara d amagnu
yella wayen i d-yeḍran d amagnu?
FirstPeriodIrregular.6: Ih, d ayen amagnu s wudem ummid. Ha-t wayen i d-yettaǧǧan azray ad yesteqrer, d wanwa i yelhan ad tmeslayeḍ ɣef waya.
FirstPeriodIrregular.8: Acimi azray ur yelli ara d amagnu deg tazwara
FirstPeriodIrregular.9: Acḥal i yettṛuḥ akken ad yesteqrer
FirstPeriodIrregular.11: Iḥormonen i d-yettwaḥkamen azray ttraǧun akud akken ad afen amiḍan-nsen. D ayen amagnu ihi ma yella izray ttili d iceṭṭaḍen, d izeggwaɣen neɣ ur ttilin ara deg yiwen n wakud deg isenyiwen imezwura.
FirstPeriodIrregular.12: Azray yezmer ad yeṭṭef yiwen neɣ sin n yiseggasen, kra yessuter ugar, akken ad yuɣal d amagnu ugar. Akud-a n usenfaṛ yemgarad aṭas seg yiwet ɣer tayeḍ, war ma d aɣbel.
FirstPeriodIrregular.14: Azray ur yelli ara d amagnu deg tazwara ur yettwaḥseb ara d aɣelluy: ddaw-ik kan yettaɛraḍ akud i s-iwulem.
FirstPeriodIrregular.15: Deg tuget n tezmert, ulac wayen ara yeḥmem. Maca, yelha ad teẓreḍ ṭṭbib ma yella lḥiḍ ur d-yettili ara deg waṭas n wayyuren sakin ma yella tzeddiḍ deg tikli n lḥiḍ-ik, neɣ ma yella ɣur-k ceṭṭ i d-yettuɣalen.
FirstPeriodIrregular.17: Ulac lḥiḍ deg waṭas n wayyuren, ticki iḥerceyen ɣezzifen aṭas, neɣ yettazzal waman aṭas n idammen.
FirstPeriodIrregular.19: Azray amagnu neɣ ur yelli ara d amagnu: d acu i d lfeṛq?
FirstPeriodIrregular.21: Lḥiḍ-ik amezwaru: d acu ara tarmeḍ
FirstPeriodIrregular.23: Isteqsiyen i d-yettuɣalen ɣef lḥiḍ-ik amezwaru
FirstPeriodIrregular.25: Lḥiḍ-iw amezwaru ur yelli ara d amagnu: yella wayen i d-yeḍran d amagnu? — AWA

FirstPeriodSigns.6: Ugris-ik yettak-ak-d tisigdin uqbel ad d-yawi lḥiḍ-ik amezwaru. Ma teẓriḍ-tent, ad k-yɛawen ur tettɣafaleḍ ara.
FirstPeriodSigns.11: Deg wayyuren uqbel lḥiḍ-ik amezwaru, ugris-ik yettbeddil s leḥnana: tawsit-ik tettbeddil, ccɛer n ugris yebda d-yettban deg yidurar imaynuten, u tidi tettbeddil daɣen. D iɣallen imagnuyen n tegzimt (puberté), ara ttheyyin ugris-ik s leḥnana.
FirstPeriodSigns.13: Isenfal-a ur ḍeggren ara akk deg yiwen n wakud, neɣ s yiwen n uɣbel, i yal yiwet — ayagi d amagnu s wudem ummid.
FirstPeriodSigns.15: Ugris-ik yettbeddil s leḥnana: tawsit-ik, ccɛer n ugris d tidi zemrent ad beddlent.
FirstPeriodSigns.17: Tiɣilt tilemẓit, tamellalt kra, tettban-d yakan kra n wayyuren uqbel lḥiḍ-ik amezwaru.
FirstPeriodSigns.19: Tzemreḍ ad tḥessseḍ aɣuṛ amecṭuḥ neɣ ccṛuṭ deg uɣaṛ-ik n wadda.
FirstPeriodSigns.21: D ayen amagnu ad tḥessseḍ yiman-ik ugar n wayen yelhan neɣ ad tcuffeḍ ɣer lɛaṭeb.
FirstPeriodSigns.23: Tzemreḍ ad tebḍuḍ kra n tɣecwiwin neɣ taqqwemt.
FirstPeriodSigns.24: Tizmilin-a ttbeggnent ayen akk belli lḥiḍ-ik amezwaru ad d-yaweḍ deg wayyuren i d-yetteddun, maca ulac anamek ad yettwassen wass ṣaḥiḥ. Ma tesḥafḍeḍ aḥfaḍ ɣer ufus, ad yuɣal d aɛadda yelhan deg waya.
FirstPeriodSigns.26: Tizmilin-a d ineggaren imagnuyen, ur d-ttbeggnent ara ayen ara yeḍran s lebɣi. Yal ugris yettṭafar abrid-is.
FirstPeriodSigns.28: Lḥiḍ-ik amezwaru: d acu ara tarmeḍ
FirstPeriodSigns.30: Amek ara ẓreɣ ma lḥiḍ-iw amezwaru yettwali-d?

HotFlashes.6: Acimi ttḍeṛṛun, amek ara tessineḍ ayen ara ten-yekkren, d wayen zemrent ad k-ɛawnent mi ara yuɣalen d ayen yeɛyan.
HotFlashes.11: Leɛwayed n yal ass i yelhan
HotFlashes.14: Tiḥemmi ttḍeṛṛunt aṭas deg usenfar ɣer tfunast (ménopause). Qqnent ihi s isenfal n iḥormonen i ɣef yettaɛraḍ uwengez ad yeḥkem deg tezmert n ugris.
HotFlashes.15: Abeddel amecṭuḥ n tezmert n ugris izmer ad yettwaḥess am tezmert tamellalt. Ugris yettarra-d s usemɣer n yiẓarren deg uglim, ayen ara d-yeǧǧen taḥmi, tazeggwaɣt, u kra tikwal tidi yeṭṭfen.
HotFlashes.17: Kra n tulawin ttḥessent kra kan n tikwal deg yimalas, anagar tiyaḍ zemrent ad ḍṛent aṭas deg wass. Tazmert d wakud zemrent daɣen ad beddlent.
HotFlashes.18: Ma ḍṛant deg tuyaḍ, tiḥemmi zemrent ad d-awint tidi n yiḍ. Zemrent ad k-ssektaqent u ad ssexsint ṭṭrad n tuyaḍ.
HotFlashes.19: Ukurri n tuyaḍ izmer ad yezwi taɛyiwt, ukkaḍ n usnuddem, d usari deg wass. Ihi yezmer ad k-yeɛawen ma tesɛedda tazmert n tuyaḍ deg uḥsab n umdan n tizmilin-ik.
HotFlashes.21: Isettasen yeṭṭawen, tazeṭṭa tafessast, d taxxamt yeqqnen s wudem i uzreg zemrent ad k-ɛawnent ad tessenqseḍ ugdil deg yiḍ.
HotFlashes.22: Kra n wayen ara d-yeǧǧen taḥmi zemrent ad tt-yessnegger neɣ ad tt-yessnerni. Ur ttesbabent ara tizmilin i yal yiwen, maca ma tessneḍ-ten ad k-yeɛawen ad tfehmeḍ ugar abrid-ik.
HotFlashes.26: Taxxamt yeḥman aṭas neɣ ilebsen imezwura aṭas
HotFlashes.28: I kra n yimalas, aru melmi ara ḍṛent tiḥemmi-ik, acḥal i yellant d wayen yeḍran qbel. Aya yezmer ad k-yeɛawen ad tafeḍ ayen ara tent-yeklen.
HotFlashes.30: Ǧǧ umkan-ik d aserkan u yettwaslik
HotFlashes.31: Sleḥ asili ɣezzifen mi ara ḍṛent tiḥemmi
HotFlashes.33: Tarrayin-a ur ttekksent ara akk tiḥemmi, maca zemrent ad ssefsun ɣer-sent u ad ssenqsent ugdil mi ara ḍṛent.
HotFlashes.34: Tiḥemmi ttḍeṛṛunt deg perimenopause d ménopause. Maca, ur tuklaleḍ ara ad tṣebṛeḍ kan ma yuɣal yeɛya ad tɛeddiḍ deg-s. Ṭṭbib neɣ tamɣart n tezmert zemrent ad xedmen aselmed ɣef tizmilin-ik u ad msawaḍen yidem-k ɣef tarrayin.
HotFlashes.35: Melmi ara tebɣiḍ ad tefkeḍ asmekti?
HotFlashes.36: Tameslayt d umusnaw tezmer ad d-tili d tlelli mi ara d-tili tizmilin d ayen aɣbel ɣer tudert-ik n yal ass neɣ mi ara tebɣiḍ ad teẓreḍ tarrayin yellan.
HotFlashes.38: Tiḥemmi neɣ tidi n yiḍ i d-yettuɣalen s waṭas i d-yeǧǧan taɛyiwt tameqqrant, taɛyiwt, neɣ ukkaḍ n uxeddim amagnu deg wass.
HotFlashes.39: Mi ara tuɣal tudert n yal ass tɛebbi
HotFlashes.40: Ma tiḥemmi ttɛekkunt amahil-ik, ineffalen-ik, inigan, tuqqna d medden, neɣ kan lehna-ik n yal ass.
HotFlashes.42: Asnerni ameɣbun deg tikli neɣ deg wazal n tizmilin d ayen yelhan ad tmeslayeḍ fell-as akken ad tafeḍ tifrat ilaqen.
HotFlashes.44: Tarrayin s iḥormonen neɣ war iḥormonen zemrent ad d-ttwafkent almend n waddad-ik. Amusnaw yezmer ad k-yeɛawen ad tmegrdeḍ lfayda, lxaṭar d tikkelt ur yelhin ara.
HotFlashes.45: Ur ttazneḍ ara kullec i tfunast
HotFlashes.46: Taḥmi tezmer ad tesɛu isebbaben yemgaraden. Kra n tizmilin zemrent daɣen ad qqnent s ddwa, aṭṭan-nniḍen, neɣ abeddel ameqqran deg tezmert-ik. Ma yella kra yettban d aɣrib, d amaynut neɣ d amaẓẓay, tafsut ad tmeslayeḍ d umusnaw weḥd-s ur tcuffeḍ ara belli d ménopause.
HotFlashes.48: Aṭṭan n uqerru n wul, tuɣalin tazzayt n tayri n usili, tuffɣa n yiman, leɛyub n tezmert tazzayt, neɣ asili ur yelli ara d amagnu deg yiwen n uḍar ssutrent ɛawen n ṭṭbib ssuref.
HotFlashes.49: Anwa tizmilin i ilaqen ad d-nesṭṭef?
HotFlashes.50: Aṭṭan n uqerru n wul, ur yelli ara d amagnu neɣ yeqqnen
HotFlashes.51: Asili tazzayt neɣ ɛuṛ ameqqran n usili
HotFlashes.52: Tuffɣa n yiman neɣ ukkaḍ n tmusni
HotFlashes.53: Taɛyiwt tazzayt, neɣ ɛuṛ deg wawal neɣ deg tmuɣli
HotFlashes.54: Asili ur yelli ara d amagnu, d aṭṭan, deg yiwen n uḍar
HotFlashes.55: D acu n tifrat i izemren ad d-tili?
HotFlashes.56: Ma yella tiḥemmi ɣeẓẓint armi ilaq ad ttwaseɛdelent, aṭas n tarrayin zemrent ad ttwaxemmem. Almend n waddad-ik, amusnaw yezmer ad msawaḍ yidem-k ɣef leɛwayed n tudert, ddwa war iḥormonen, neɣ, ma yelha, ddwa s iḥormonen.

Istihada.17: Istihâda d azray yettili beṛṛa n uzray amagnu n lḥiḍ, neɣ yettṛajun ugar n wakud n lḥiḍ yettwassnen deg ddin n Lislam. Istihada.19: Agbur-a yesfeḍ amnaḍ s wudem amatu; ur k-yeǧǧa ara ad tessneḍ ma yella azray udmawan yemṣada d Istihâda deg waddad-ik.
Istihada.20: Izmer ad yuɣal yeɛya ad temgaradeḍ Istihâda d lḥiḍ neɣ azray ur nelli ara d amagnu, acku azray yezmer ad yettban yemṣada, ad yemgarad deg tezmert, neɣ ad yettṛaǧu s wudem ur nelli ara d amagnu. Ineɛlamen-nniḍen ssnen aya, ayen ara d-yeǧǧen aṭas n tarrayin i wakken ad tt-tafeḍ.
Istihada.22: D ayen amagnu ur teẓriḍ ara sya yakan acu i yeqqnen azray ur nelli ara d amagnu; arraw n lḥal-a d amatu, d ayen ur nelli ara d ccek fell-ak.
Istihada.23: Kra n wayen zemrent ad k-yeɛawen deg uxemmim, war ma d ilugan imatuten, acku tamaruyin yemgaraden almend n tmedresin n fiqh.

Istihada.33: Tamaruyin-a d ayen amatu, ur d-ttbeggnent ara iɣerzan imekmal: ineɛlamen d tmedresin n fiqh zemrent ad ten-fehmen s wudem yemgaraden.
Istihada.34: Ma tefkeḍ akud ad tɛassed azray-ik deg waṭas n wussan, war ma tessegrawed, ad k-yeɛawen ad tfehmeḍ waddad-ik ugar uqbel ad tefkeḍ ccek.
